%% 8 Data Stores D1[(\"D1: User Accounts Store\")]:::storeNode D2[(\"D2: Inventory Ledger\")]:::storeNode D3[(\"D3: Operations Logs\")]:::storeNode D4[(\"D4: Financial Ledger\")]:::storeNode D5[(\"D5: Supplier Directory\")]:::storeNode D6[(\"D6: Asset Registry\")]:::storeNode D7[(\"D7: Tasks & Schedules\")]:::storeNode D8[(\"D8: Offline Sync Queue\")]:::storeNode
%% 10 Core Processes (Strictly synced to WBS Verbs) P1((\"1.0
Govern User Access
and Permissions\")):::processNode P2((\"2.0
Administer Inventory
and Storage Locations\")):::processNode P3((\"3.0

and Care Cycles\")):::processNode P4((\"4.0

and Operating Margins\")):::processNode P5((\"5.0

and Visual Analytics\")):::processNode P6((\"6.0
Manage Suppliers and
Procurement Lifecycles\")):::processNode P7((\"7.0

and Fixed Assets\")):::processNode P8((\"8.0

and APIs\")):::processNode

%% Flows: Farm Manager E_Manager -->|\"1: User registration details<br/>2: Role assignments\"| P1 E_Manager -->|\"Task assignment\"| P8 E_Manager -->|\"1: Category & location definitions<br/>2: Deletion authorization\"| P2 P2 -->|\"Deletion audit report\"| E_Manager E_Manager -->|\"1: Care cycle schedule configuration<br/>2: Activity validation decision\"| P3 E_Manager -->|\"Stock summary filter request\"| P5 P5 -->|\"1: Low-stock alert<br/>2: Operational summary report\"| E_Manager
%% Flows: Weather Service E_Weather -->|\"Weather forecast feed\"| P10 P10 -->|\"Enriched weather data\"| P5
%% Flows: Supplier E_Supplier -->|\"Delivery note & catalog update\"| P2 P6 -->|\"Purchase order\"| E_Supplier P2 -->|\"Receiving slip\"| E_Supplier E_Supplier -->|\"Vendor catalog & price list\"| P6
%% Flows: Customer E_Customer -->|\"Sales order\"| P2 P2 -->|\"Sales dispatch notice\"| E_Customer
%% Flows: Farm Owner E_Owner -->|\"1: Revenue entry<br/>2: Margin query\"| P4 E_Owner -->|\"Executive report filter request\"| P5 P4 -->|\"Profit margin statement\"| E_Owner P5 -->|\"Executive dashboard\"| E_Owner P7 -->|\"Asset service alert\"| E_Owner
%% Flows: ERP P10 -->|\"Exported general ledger batch\"| E_ERP
%% Internal Data Store Connections (Single Direction Only) P1 -->|\"Write credentials\"| D1 D1 -->|\"Read permissions\"| P1
P2 -->|\"Write stock balances\"| D2 D2 -->|\"Read stock quantities\"| P2 P2 -->|\"Linked financial record\"| P4
P3 -->|\"Write activity logs\"| D3 D3 -->|\"Read pending logs\"| P3 P3 -->|\"Material depletion order\"| D2 D2 -->|\"Read available material stock\"| P3
P4 -->|\"Write journal entry\"| D4 D4 -->|\"Read ledger accounts\"| P4
D2 -->|\"Balances\"| P5 D4 -->|\"Totals\"| P5
P6 -->|\"Write vendor profiles\"| D5 D5 -->|\"Read supplier directory\"| P6
P7 -->|\"Write repair histories\"| D6 D6 -->|\"Read machinery status\"| P7
P8 -->|\"Write task status\"| D7 D7 -->|\"Read worker tasks\"| P8
